description: This PHP class 'InstallStorage' in the Drupal core handles filesystem scanning for configuration files during the installation process. It discovers extension directories, manages configuration file paths, and restricts write/delete operations, specifically for the installer environment.

classes.name: InstallStorage
classes.description: A storage class used during Drupal installation to discover and manage configuration files across extensions and core.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the InstallStorage with a specified directory and collection.

methods.name: getFilePath
methods.description: Returns the filesystem path to a configuration file based on its name.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a configuration name exists in the discovered folders.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Throws exception; write operation is not permitted.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws exception; delete operation is not permitted.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Throws exception; rename operation is not permitted.

methods.name: listAll
methods.description: Lists all configuration names, optionally filtered by prefix.

methods.name: getAllFolders
methods.description: Discovers and caches all configuration folders from core and extensions.

methods.name: getComponentNames
methods.description: Gets configuration folders for a list of extensions.

methods.name: getCoreNames
methods.description: Gets configuration folders for Drupal core.

methods.name: getComponentFolder
methods.description: Returns the folder path for a given extension component.

methods.name: getCoreFolder
methods.description: Returns the core configuration folder path.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Throws exception; bulk delete is not permitted.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the internal cache of folders.
